item.text:
**6B.10 Research Note**

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran (Islamic Republic of)](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/iran-%28islamic-republic-of%29) | WHO | 2024 | https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/iran-%28islamic-republic-of%29 | Best positive signal I found: WHO describes free primary healthcare, good vaccination coverage, declining child mortality, and equity-oriented work on social determinants and healthy cities. This suggests some basic life chances improved in a sectoral sense, but it does not show broad, durable gains in opportunity across society. | 6B.10 |
| [Pezeshkian Cabinet: Profiles](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/aug/22/pezeshkian-cabinet-profiles) | The Iran Primer / USIP | 2024-08-22 | https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/aug/22/pezeshkian-cabinet-profiles | Weak positive evidence: the cabinet included technocrats and academics, and Pezeshkian had Khamenei’s approval before submitting it. That points to some tolerance for competence-based staffing, but the article frames it as compromise inside a hardliner-dominated system, not a structural uplift in ordinary people’s life chances. | 6B.10 |
| [Khamenei protege, sole moderate neck and neck in Iran presidential race](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-27 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514 | Negative evidence: Reuters says voter apathy was driven by economic hardships and social restrictions, while candidates avoided concrete economic plans. That reads as a system managing legitimacy under strain, not one clearly improving ordinary people’s prospects. | 6B.10 |
| [Iran's water crisis leads to alarming ground collapse](https://amp.dw.com/en/irans-water-crisis-leads-to-alarming-ground-collapse/a-69405927) | DW | 2024-06-19 | https://amp.dw.com/en/irans-water-crisis-leads-to-alarming-ground-collapse/a-69405927 | Strong negative evidence on basic living conditions: drought and water shortages are causing land subsidence, threatening Tehran and hundreds of other towns, with experts saying at least half of society is affected. That cuts directly against a claim of improved life chances. | 6B.10 |
| [Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/) | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/ | Strong negative evidence, especially for women and poorer households: Amnesty says the new law adds severe penalties, expands police/security enforcement, and disproportionately burdens economically disadvantaged women and girls. This narrows, rather than expands, life chances. | 6B.10 |
| [Iran: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024 | Broad negative background: Khamenei and unelected institutions dominate, corruption remains endemic, IRGC and bonyads are above scrutiny, women and minorities face discrimination, and some provinces remain underdeveloped. This is strong evidence against equal and widely shared opportunity. | 6B.10 |

Search gap: I found only narrow positives, mostly in health-system delivery and technocratic staffing. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei left ordinary people with broadly better life chances in the bigger sense of durable mobility, housing affordability, equal treatment, or regional opportunity.

My inference from the evidence is **weak negative**: there were some sectoral and administrative improvements, but not a durable, broad-based improvement in ordinary people’s life chances once the sanctions, repression, environmental stress, inequality, and capture constraints are accounted for.
